speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please tell me your age and how long you have had these skin lesions. To better understand them, can you describe their color, size, and if they are itchy, painful, or bleeding?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Varicella (Chickenpox)

Given the daycare exposure and brother's recent chickenpox, I suspect varicella despite the lesions being described as painless papules. Can you confirm if any new lesions are appearing daily or if there are any vesicles (fluid-filled blisters) present?
